Class SealedCodec<T>

java.lang.Object
forj.json.SealedCodec<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Codec<T>
public final class SealedCodec<T> extends Object implements Codec<T>
Codec.sealed(String): a closed family of cases (a sealed interface and its records) as JSON objects that name their case in a discriminator field, written first: {"type":"card","number":"4111…"}.

Each case keeps its own codec, usually a Codec.product(Function, Codec.Field...): encoding wraps the writer so the discriminator goes in as the object's first field, and decoding reads the discriminator, then hands the open object to the case's codec. Missing fields, optional fields and error paths behave exactly as they do for that codec on its own.
